Entry 6: Enemies Part 1:
So far, with the data Kleopatra has collected so far, here are the types of demons that are normally encountered:
Chaos Pawns: These are posssesed corpses of fallen soldiers on our side. 
They are stupid and slow and shoot without care, percision, or a fast pace. In large groups they can be overwhelming.
Just keep your distance and keep moving and you'll be fine.
Chaos Soldiers: These are demons that show themselves as giant monsters with giant cannons on their backs. 
Their aim isn't the best, they keep accidentally aiming very slightly downwards. Just keep your distance and keep moving.
Only then will you be fine.
Chaos Fiends: These are animalistic demons. They can tear through anything and can jump super high.
Don't think your safe just because you are on high ground. Just keep moving and make sure to keep your distance around them.
